title: Penthouse Magazine January 1979 Holiday Issue Complete w/ Centerfold Nkomo
condition_description: Vintage 1979 issue. Covers bright with light scuffing; small chips and wear along the spine edge at the lower left; toning on the back cover. No tears. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
description:
Penthouse magazine, January 1979 - Special Holiday Issue, original $2.50 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover features: eyewitness report on the last days of Rhodesia and an exclusive interview with Joshua Nkomo; Murder at West Point by Lucian Truscott IV; psychiatric concentration camps; Love and Hate in Hollywood.

Back cover: Tareyton Lights cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
